card.name: Linking words before effect or reaction terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'and', 'than' and 'The' inside drug-interaction and overdose sentences, just before words like effects, reactions or concomitant use. Also fires on a few mid-word spots in drug names.

modes.label: Linking word before effects
modes.description: A word like 'and' or 'of' that sits right before 'adverse reactions' or 'pre-existing' conditions in interaction text.
modes.example: which could increase or prolong both the therapeutic effects<< and>> adverse reactions, and may cause serious respiratory

modes.label: Comparison or section opener
modes.description: 'than' after 'higher' or 'The' starting an interaction clinical-impact line.
modes.example: following ingestion of a higher<< than>> recommended dosing regimen in Trial 3

modes.label: Inside drug or metabolite names
modes.description: Partway through a drug or metabolite word in interaction text.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward purpose or intent words and away from words about accidental or unintended events.
card.plain: It marks small connecting words in drug-interaction text that come before a statement about effects or reactions.
